description: Three engineering students from Euromed University of Fes. One question every Moroccan farmer asks each autumn: what do I plant this year? We are Astravia: Hajar Belghali (team leader, cybersecurity), Chaimae Ouarab (software engineering) and Houda Fettouh (cybersecurity). We built SAMA (سما, “sky”) to turn forty years of NASA data into a voice farmers can follow, in Darija, Arabic, French and English. Honest by design. Rooted in Moroccan fields.
